name: single pi+/pi-
description: One charged pion per event, charge drawn per event from {pi+, pi-} with equal probability. Kinetic energy uniform in [200, 2000] MeV, isotropic direction. Replaces the former 03_pi_plus / 05_pi_minus pair, matching 02_mu and 04_e: one config per species, charge sampled. Note the two charges are LESS alike than for mu: pi+ at rest decays to mu+ nu, while pi- is captured by a nucleus and its rest mass goes into nuclear fragments and secondary pions rather than a clean decay chain. The Cherenkov light along the track is identical, so reconstruction cannot pick the charge, but the end-of-range signature differs and the mixed set is what states how often each appears. Expressed through the bomb source with min_particles = max_particles = 1 -- a two-entry `particles` list would put BOTH charges in every event (generate_macro.py emits one /gun/addPrimary per entry), which is not the same sample.
